explanation: AbdomenAtlas 3.0 includes CT scans from KiTS'23. Table 1 lists 489, the same number as the public KiTS23 training cases in this catalogue, although its per-dataset counts add up to more than the 9,262 total. They are the same scans, not additional patients. AbdomenAtlas adds organ masks (from AbdomenAtlas 1.1), organ sub-region and blood-vessel masks, and generated reports. Table 1 counts 452 of these scans with kidney tumour annotations both in KiTS'23 and in AbdomenAtlas 3.0. The paper says the source datasets' ground truth was used where available. Whether the kidney lesion masks of these scans are KiTS'23's own labels, and whether KiTS'23 cysts are in them, is not stated. The release has no column naming the source dataset, but DeepTumorVQA's ID mapping gives it. The mapping puts 489 KiTS cases under 665 BDMAP IDs, 176 of which look like second copies (see the overlap record).
